skill.summary: Generate publication-ready scientific articles in PDF format with AI-powered research and citations

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Scientific Article PDF Generator skill.

- Generate publication-ready scientific articles in PDF format with AI-powered content enrichment and citations.
- Supports adding product information, research focus, and data visualizations (charts).
- Customizable options for deep research mode, source inclusion, and citation formatting.
- Simple API integration with detailed parameter support.
- Automatic PDF download in browser; generation time: 2–5 minutes.
- Provides clear workflow, error handling, and user prompts for efficient scientific writing.
